profile.name: Rohit Kumar Singh
profile.intro: Full-stack engineer building AI retrieval and agent systems that hold up in production. Experienced with high-performance C++ engines, vector indexing, and scalable web apps.
notes: Pursuing B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (IOT) at Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology (SGPA: 8.52/10, expected July 2027).
Built a Vector Database from scratch in C++ with HNSW indexing and an Ollama-driven RAG pipeline, alongside a 1000+ pkts/sec Deep Packet Inspection engine.
Active problem solver with 500+ DSA problems solved on LeetCode, dedicated to clean architectures, efficient thread management, and low-latency systems.
